calm.transcript: Concurrently, Teuvo Kohonen invented self-organizing maps, showing that uncoordinated, localized competition between neighboring units could spontaneously fold a high-dimensional feature space into a beautifully ordered topological manifold.

excited.transcript: In 1949, Canadian psychologist Donald Hebb published The Organization of Behavior, introducing his foundational postulate of synaptic plasticity. When an axon of cell A is near enough to excite cell B and repeatedly takes part in firing it, some growth process or metabolic change takes place.

serious.transcript: For decades, this was viewed as the holy grail of artificial intelligence. It promised networks that could learn continuously without catastrophic forgetting, growing new modules dynamically as needed.
